title: Somatosensory evoked potentials in the human spinal cord to mixed nerve stimulation
description: This dataset contains simultaneous electroencephalography (EEG), electrospinography (ESG), electroneurography (ENG), and electromyography (EMG) recordings from 40 participants, together with electrocardiographic and respiratory signals. Four conditions were recorded: resting state with eyes open, mixed median nerve stimulation, mixed tibial nerve stimulation, and alternating median/tibial stimulation. ESG electrode positions are provided for each participant. The study was pre-registered on OSF.
methods_description: Simultaneous EEG, ESG, ENG and EMG were recorded, along with ECG and respiration, during rest with eyes open and during mixed median nerve, tibial nerve, and alternating median/tibial nerve stimulation. The EEG channel Fz was referenced to the right mastoid and, separately, to the 6th thoracic vertebra (TH6) for ESG. Data are in EEGLAB format organized per BIDS.
